title: Help with benefit applications
intro: We help Tower Hamlets residents navigate the benefits system and apply for support so they can maximise their income and receive their full entitlement.

blocks.heading: Benefits we can help with
paragraphs: Personal Independence Payment (PIP), Attendance Allowance, Disability Living Allowance for disabled children, Pension Credit, Council Tax Reduction, Carer’s Allowance and Universal Credit.

blocks.heading: Who can use this service
paragraphs: This service is for Tower Hamlets residents only.

blocks.heading: Contact the advice team
paragraphs: Call 0800 808 5701 or email advice@toynbeehall.org.uk. If you need help with something else, contact us and we will point you in the right direction.
